title: game/words.json
description: The target-language words the game itself uses (CONTENT_PLAN 3.3, C05; schema 2: the key words moved to the NPC files, VILLAGE_PLAN V01): the guide's directions, the units and joiners, the button labels, the support headings, the pronouns, the help lines, the near future, the greeting, the typing help's letters and the nouns the logic is about. Loaded by GameWords (Vocaterra.Game.Core); the grammar check reads them.

directions.description: The direction phrases of the guide's answers.

blockUnit.description: The unit of a distance (bloque); the template pluralises it.

listJoiner.description: The word between the last two parts of a list (y).

unseen.description: The label of a thing not seen yet (¿?).

pronouns.description: The subject pronoun of each row of the conjugation tables.

helpLine.description: The line the help button says.

dontKnowLine.description: The line the I-don't-know button says.

nearFuture.description: ir a + infinitive: the verb, its joiner, and the time words that make a present a plan (at an ir-a or a fut step of a lesson). A time word of several words (semana que viene) is matched as a whole, its words in order (V16).

obligation.description: tener que + infinitive (V21b, the book's column "must"): the verb, in the present, and the word between it and the infinitive.

greeting.description: The greeting the mic check asks for (hola).

greetingOpenings.description: The greetings a learner's line may open with (NpcTurnRules' Greeting, V15): each phrase is matched word by word, without accents and case. Matching only; the grammar check does not read it.

addressPronouns.description: The address pronouns by role (tú, usted, ustedes), matched against the core's lemmas (V28, the off-prompt rule). Matching only.

nameDeterminers.description: The words before a name that make it a common noun (la luz, el domingo; RecastNames, V20). Matching only.

vocativeBinders.description: The words before a trailing name that make it a noun of the sentence (el pan de Luz; Vocative, V14). Matching only.

vocativeJoiners.description: The words after a leading name that join it to another noun (Luz y Domingo comieron pan; Vocative, V14). Matching only.

quantityArticles.description: The indefinite articles that count one item when the line names no number (vendo un bloque de madera; NpcEffect.CountedSlots, V15b). Matching only.

nouns.description: The catalogue nouns the game's logic is about, by role.

yes.description: Lines that take the class a teacher offers (L01).

no.description: Lines that decline it at no cost.

ask.description: Lines that ask a teacher for a class (the core has no intent for them).

classAnswers.description: The plain answers to a teacher's offer of a class and the ways to ask for one (L01, D-game-25); the game reads them from the text of a turn.

places.description: The places of the scene that are no catalogue noun, by neutral id (T03): the word the beacon shows for a label of game/scene.json whose id game/nouns.json does not have (village: pueblo, waterfall: cascada). A label id that is a noun id shows the noun's lemma.

hudLines.description: The player's own words on the HUD (N05): the needs' stage lines by the key game/needs.json names (need.thirst.3), the death screen (hud.camp), the beacon's label on the chest (hud.belongings) and the words of the inventory's needs list (hud.fine, hud.name.<need>). Text only, never recorded (D-game-13); each key has its English in the locale under the same id.

typing.description: The Alt-key map of the typing help (G5): with Alt held, the key types the character; with Shift and a shifted key, the shifted character. Letters are the capitals with Shift; a German map gives ä, ö, ü, ß.

key.description: The key, as it types without modifiers.

shifted.description: What the key types with Shift, when it is not the capital (the question mark on the / key).

alt.description: What Alt and the key type.
